basic_info.description: New Price!  Welcome to 48 Terra Vista Avenue #A in the central neighborhood of Anza Vista. This is a TIC unit in a 4 unit TIC building with fractional TIC financing. This 1 bedroom, 1 bath unit comes with a private/deeded expansive deck (625 sq.ft. per graphic artist) with city views as well as it's own side by side deeded garage parking space. Owner can park a 2nd car in the driveway behind their deeded space. Enjoy hardwood floors, clean/modern lines and updated kitchen/bath. The bedroom has plantation shutters and a walk-in closet. The bathroom has a skylight and pedestal sink. Welcome Home!
